purpose: Technical coordinator of a finite preselection research batch; content work is recorded separately in role events and essay lineages. No comparative tournament or ten-selection.
fresh_review_input: Only its own full manuscript, neutral criteria, rules summary. No other essay, author biography, production metadata or old rating. Coordinator checks prior responses separately.
author_input: Only the same essay current text, assigned problem and accepted relevant source/argument evidence; no other manuscripts or global ratings.
execution: The eight targeted lines are handled in the stated order. Independent current-version checks may occupy spare slots without influencing another essay. At most three content agents concurrently.
selection_rule: Keep a sufficiently supported selected version for later comparison; defer if a material unresolved defect remains after the finite attempt. Newer is not automatically better. Narrowing and remaining novelty/significance uncertainty must be explicit.
archive: Freeze inputs/prompts before dispatch. Canonical archive plus exact hashes and lineage before dependent critique/revision. Preserve failures and disagreements. Bounded visible capture, no hidden reasoning or wholesale native transcript.
stop: All fifteen assigned lines closed with version choice/reason and all22 register updated; do not select ten or publish/submit. Actual quota failure stops dispatch and preserves continuation; no quota scheduler.
